# ferriskey_authz_policy (Resource)

Manages a Cedar authorization policy of a FerrisKey realm. A policy is either **static** (`source` holds Cedar text) or **linked** (`template_id` plus `links` instantiate a `ferriskey_authz_template`). The server validates every enabled policy against the realm schema on each write, so a policy that references types or actions declared in a `ferriskey_authz_schema` must depend on it (reference it or use `depends_on`). The Cedar text is stored and returned verbatim, so there is no normalization drift. Writes to a realm's authorization rules are serialized by the provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_authz_policy" "allow_read" {
  realm  = ferriskey_authz_schema.main.realm
  name   = "allow-read"
  source = "permit(principal, action == App::Action::\"read\", resource);"
}

resource "ferriskey_authz_policy" "editors_read" {
  realm       = ferriskey_authz_schema.main.realm
  name        = "editors-read"
  template_id = ferriskey_authz_template.role_can_read.template_id

  links = {
    "?principal" = {
      type = "FerrisKey::Role"
      id   = "editor"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Policy name, unique within the realm. Letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `.` and `:` only (max 128 characters).
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the policy belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy takes part in evaluation. Defaults to `true`.
- `links` (Attributes Map) Template slot assignments of a linked policy, keyed by slot (`?principal` or `?resource`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--links))
- `managed_by` (String) Optional manager label (lowercase letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`; max 64 characters) stamped on the policy so several tools can own disjoint policy sets. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `source` (String) Cedar policy text of a static policy. Exactly one of `source` or `template_id` must be set.
- `template_id` (String) UUID of the `ferriskey_authz_template` a linked policy instantiates. Requires `links`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{uuid}`.
- `origin` (String) How the policy was authored, as reported by the API (`custom` for static, `generated` for linked, `builtin`).
- `policy_id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the policy.

<a id="nestedatt--links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `links`

Required:

- `id` (String) Entity identifier.
- `type` (String) Cedar entity type, e.g. `FerrisKey::Role`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_authz_policy.allow_read acme/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
